correctness.rationale: PASS for the narrowly stated feasibility equivalence. For s∈(0,1],r∈(0,1],p∈(0,1], the endpoints of Barsukow Eq (118) have positive denominators, and for p<s nonemptiness is equivalent to (s-p)/(1-s/6)≤1 and ≤(1+rs-p)/(1+s/6). The first is s≤6(1+p)/7; crossmultiplication of the second gives (1+r)s²+(7−6r−2p)s−6≤0. The positive quadratic root yields exactly the stated s_max and limiting p↓0 yields uniform s_star, with breakpoint r=1/6. For p≥s the same bounds hold automatically. This is a correct algebraic translation of the published interval; it is NOT a sharp CFL necessity for any solver.
